autonomyAvailability.why: post-fix (2026-11-22T02:00:00Z → 2026-11-22T18:25:00Z): 64/65 slots good (1 empty, of which 1 drift slips; 0 refused), Wilson low 0.9179 ⇒ the volume supports NO candidate yet; earliest support if every future slot is good: 97% ≈ 2026-11-24T00:25:00.000Z, 98% ≈ 2026-11-25T00:10:00.000Z, 99% ≈ 2026-11-27T22:55:00.000Z. Residual (non-organizational) bad slots 2026-11-08T00:00:00Z → asOf = 15/1417 (1.06%: 14 empty slots of which 10 drift slips, 1 legitimate/integrity refusals), Wilson of good [0.9826, 0.9936] — a COUNTERFACTUAL estimate, not a post-fix measurement. Timer drift alone (OnUnitActiveSec=15min + default AccuracySec: the tick fires slightly later than every 15 min, so some grid slots get no tick) costs ≈0.71% of slots and is charged as unavailable (fail-closed): that is a systematic floor that would consume most of a 99% budget (1%) but leaves room under 98% (2%). 98% is kept PROVISIONAL (not raised to 99%) because (a) only the post-fix window is measured and it supports nothing yet, (b) drift + one ~4 h host/timer outage (16 slots) fit the 14-day 98% budget (≈26.88 slots) but not 99% (≈13.44). Upgrade path (PROPOSED): 99% only if, after ≥ 14 post-fix days, the measured slot Wilson low is ≥ 0.99.

ciMainPush.why: SLI 0.9941 = 841/846 counted push-to-main runs (bad by conclusion {"failure":5}; 18 cancelled excluded as superseded, 0 pending), window 2026-10-25T20:24:28Z → 2026-11-22T17:43:52Z (27.89 days — the full push-to-main history the API returned at 2026-11-22T18:18:28Z, NOT a rolling 30-day window), Wilson 95% [0.9862, 0.9975]. Re-runs: attemptInfo FIRST_ATTEMPT, 0 run(s) with run_attempt > 1 ⇒ no red-then-green re-run is hidden in this window (none — first-attempt outcome counted). 97%: SUPPORTED, budget left 0.803; 98%: SUPPORTED, budget left 0.7045; 98.5%: SUPPORTED, budget left 0.606; 99%: INCONCLUSIVE, budget left 0.409. Rule: tightest candidate inside the interval with budget not exhausted ⇒ 0.99. The r0 98% came from mixing pull_request runs (530 in the snapshot, 14 bad = the check catching bad PR code) into the SLI; on main-push alone 98% is already met with margin (too loose to detect a degradation). Budget figures are computed over the 27.89-day window above; at ~30.33 main pushes/day a 30-day 99% budget would be ≈9.1 failures. 99% is a target, NOT a claim that it is met (it is inside the interval, i.e. unproven).
